context: A senpai and a teen chat
purpose: Teach: 応対/兆候/日にち/一軒/足音/数え切れ/無性に/レシート

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 桜、研究室の応対、教授に学ぼう。
lines.en: Sakura—pay attention to how the professor handles questions in the lab. It's worth studying.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but not cold. A slight lean forward. The tone of someone who's already learned this lesson and is passing it on without fuss.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。風邪の兆候、出ているので、無理しないようにします。
lines.en: I will. I think I'm catching a cold, so I'll make sure not to overdo it.
lines.style: Genuine concern layered underneath compliance. Slight apologetic edge—she's been taught to minimize her own needs. Quiet and steady.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 発表の日にち、来週末だ。
lines.style: Flat statement, almost a reminder-to-himself. The kind of thing you say out loud to make it real. No inflection to soften it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 駅前の一軒のカフェ、勉強場所に活用してます。
lines.en: I've been using that café near the station as my study spot.
lines.style: Lighter here—a small brightness creeping in. She's sharing something practical, maybe even a little proud of having figured it out. Conversational, not performative.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 廊下の足音、教授のリズム、覚えた?
lines.en: Have you figured out the professor's footsteps yet? His rhythm in the hallway?
lines.style: Dry humor just underneath. Not mocking—affectionate observation. The kind of thing you ask someone you've watched fumble through nerves before. Wry but warm.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。問題集、数え切れないほど解きました。
lines.en: Yes. I've worked through so many practice problems I've lost count.
lines.style: Earnest pride without bragging. Each word deliberate. A small satisfaction underneath—she's done the work. Steady tempo, no rush.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 発表後、無性に走り出したい気持ちになる。
lines.en: After the presentation, I'll probably feel this crazy urge to just run.
lines.style: Admitting something—not quite a confession, but close. Slightly embarrassed by the feeling itself. Quieter on the 'run' part, like he's surprised by his own body's honesty.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。会計のレシート、ファイルしておきます。
lines.en: Got it. I'll make sure all the receipts are filed and accounted for.
lines.style: Brisk, capable close. She's moving into action mode. No lingering—purposeful and organized. A small confidence in the delivery.
